Law LLB at University of Leeds

What University of Leeds asks of applicants to Law LLB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Leeds courses · Law field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 4 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US High School Diploma (living in the US): the standard academic requirement is the diploma with a minimum 3.0 GPA, two Honors classes at A+ to B, and at least one further qualification (AP at 4–5, IB HL course, dual-enrolment course, or a pre-2021 SAT II) — the SAT/ACT is not listed as part of it
  • SAT 1290 (650 Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, 620 Maths) or ACT 26 in English is accepted as evidence of English language ability

University-wide guidance on Leeds’ admissions-qualifications page for the USA (undated, current); it is not specific to this course.

Verified19 Oct 2026Leeds: Admissions qualifications – United States of America
English language
  • IELTS: 6.5 overall with no less than 6.0 in any component (other tests: Leeds’ English language equivalent qualifications)
  • GCSE English Language grade 5/6 (B) for applicants from countries where English is not the first language
Verified19 Oct 2026Leeds: Law LLB (2027 entry)
